big: A defence firm has an order book three to five times its yearly revenue. Sounds safe. But revenue arrives as milestones are met, and delays can push it out. A big order book is not the same as big profit this year.

lines: Order book divided by annual revenue. Three to five times is common for defence companies. Revenue is milestone-based and working capital can be heavy. Execution delays shift revenue and hit earnings even when orders are strong. Nomination-based orders to DPSUs reduce competition risk but cap margins.

rows: delays move revenue to later years
